verdict.rationale: BILL S&E docs say you can set up budgets, users, and virtual cards through the API, and the product page promises cards where every transaction is controlled. That covers virtual card issuance and budget-based control. However, physical cards, explicit per-card spend limits, and issuance speed are never documented. Missing for 10: explicit physical card issuance, documented per-card spend limit configuration, evidence that cards are issued in minutes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
